# Fusion Pixel 12px menu font

Original: https://github.com/TakWolf/fusion-pixel-font/releases/tag/2026.10.25
Faces: fusion-pixel-12px-monospaced-zh_hans.bdf and fusion-pixel-12px-monospaced-ja.bdf.

Losslessly compressed upstream sources are retained here. OFL.txt and LICENSES retain the original font and component notices. Generated UiFont.bin uses printable BMP glyphs excluding Hangul/Jamo and oversized presentation ligatures; UiFontJa.bin stores sparse Japanese glyph overrides. Neither font is scaled at runtime. Run python3 tools/build_ui_font.py to regenerate. Normal NDS builds use the committed binaries and need no Python or network.

The font's OFL does not assign a license to the rest of NGPDS.
